decisions.issues: Minor only. Nagoji's head is bowed toward the map, which reads as brooding more than actively shaking his head, but it still fits the beat. Three turbaned guards stand in the background; the script does not call for them, but they suit the war hall. Lettering space is acceptable but moderate. The plain wall above the left guard (upper left) can take Nagoji's medium balloon, and the wall with window slits at upper right can take Varma's short one. Nagoji matches his sheet and the bible: thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, small flush gold stud, topknot with grey temples, white coat, red waistcoat, silver chain of office, riding boots and the scar on his left forearm. Varma matches too: bare-headed with a side knot above his left ear, bare-chested, cream mundu with gold border, gold necklaces and a spear by the platform. His hands are sound on the rail. The map is drawn in ink lines only, with no lettering anywhere.
